title: Inspection training record
description: One product, the protocol generated for it, and what a technician established during the physical inspection. One JSON object per line (JSONL). Designed to support supervised training (input → required parameter ids), fine-tuning (input → protocol), retrieval (similar past products and their protocols) and evaluation. See dataset/README.md.

productKey.description: Normalised 'brand|model' (or 'generic|<product type>'). Splits are grouped on this key so the same product never appears in both training and test data.

source.description: technician_feedback = from a real inspection; expert_annotation = a reviewer labelled it without inspecting; benchmark = hand-authored acceptance case (evaluation only, never training).

input.description: Exactly the InputSchema object (schema.js) the generator received.

protocol.description: What was generated, so feedback is tied to a model version.

requiredParameterIds.description: Checks the technician confirms were needed for this product (positive labels).

irrelevantParameterIds.description: Generated checks the technician marked not applicable (negative labels — feed precision).

missingChecks.description: Checks the technician had to add (recall failures). New recurring ones become library parameters.

observations.description: Claim vs actual, per parameter. Evidence references point to photos/documents stored by the inspection workflow.
